interpretation_limits: No equivalence to the fresh-prefix generation execution path is claimed.
The observed maximum is specific to 14 artificial diagnostic positions, not a formal-population error bound or a noise threshold.
Differences need not cancel in self-minus-empty paired comparisons.
Conversation-cluster bootstrap intervals quantify sampling uncertainty only and exclude numerical execution-path uncertainty.
